reason: Although an anthropoid coffin lid has a face and collar that can superficially resemble a standing figure, the surrounding sandstone plinth top plane (rows 5-21), the unchanged south foot-end wall of the coffin box (rows 18-21), and the 10-row two-tiered plinth front face below (rows 22-31) clearly anchor it as a horizontal sarcophagus in 3/4 top-down view. The open state confirms the 3/4 geometry by exposing the recessed north/west inner trough walls above the horizontal mummy while keeping the south foot-end wall and plinth front face intact.
